sloka: राजन्प्रभुर्यतो ऽस्माकं वसिष्ठो भगवानृषिः ।प्रतिशप्तुं न शक्तस्त्वं देवतुल्यं पुरोधसम् ।। ७.६५.३० ॥
transliteration: rājanprabhuryato 'smākaṁ vasiṣṭho bhagavānṛṣiḥ ।pratiśaptuṁ na śaktastvaṁ devatulyaṁ purodhasam ।। 7.65.30 ॥

translations.english: She said, "O King, because the revered sage Vasistha is our master, you are not capable of cursing back this god-like priest."
